codazzi_residual_convention: div(Sigma) + kappa*q/H^2 in normalized tetrad units
scope: finite homogeneous deterministic T/E/B sky; C_lm is the oriented complex outer product. Fixed initial data and orientation; no primordial covariance or data likelihood.

controls.analytic_law: T_sky proportional to 1/[gamma (1-beta dot n_sky)], normalized by its full-sky mean
